title: Cape Reckoning Rising
premise: Cyrus Nystrom, a railroad engineer who keeps the map of the Cape Reckoning's abandoned spur lines, learns that the survey expedition led by her estranged mentor, Odile Marsh, has gone silent upriver near the drowned town of Kestrel Bend. Racing a salvage fleet that wants the wreck's sealed cargo — a pre-war treasury shipment that could buy the whole territory — Cyrus follows the dead lines by rail, water, and foot, discovering that Odile went silent deliberately, guarding evidence that the salvage company's owner murdered his own partners decades ago. Over six tides, Cyrus must reach the wreck, choose between the fortune and the truth, and expose the crime through the testimony of the drowned town's last survivor, because the law has been bought and the river is the only honest witness. The story ends with the salvage fleet scattered, the cargo surrendered to the flood, and Cyrus burning her own map — keeping only the line that leads home.
about_author: Lior Vane is the pen name of a former surveyor's assistant who spent six years mapping decommissioned rail lines along the northern coast before turning to fiction. Vane writes adventure stories about people who trust terrain more than institutions.
